q: How do I stop the same invoice being counted twice in my carbon figures?
title: Same invoice counted twice
short: Give every invoice one identity: supplier GSTIN plus invoice number, or a file fingerprint. Check every new upload against that list before it is added. Duplicates usually arrive as a scan and an email copy of the same bill, or a revised invoice that replaces an older one.
audience: Finance and admin teams collecting invoices

ul: Scan and emailed PDF of the same bill.
A revised invoice that replaces an earlier one.
Two people uploading the same month.

p: Keep the replaced invoice on file but marked as superseded, so the trail shows why only one counts.

senseible: Senseible fingerprints every document, so the same bill uploaded twice is recognised and counted once.

sources.label: ISO 14064-3, verification of greenhouse gas statements (iso.org)
